Thought → tool call → observation → … → final answer
step budget 10 (sub-agents 6–7) · narrated tool call → retry with tool_choice=required
unknown tool / tool exception → error observation, run continues
refused tools removed from the offered schema for the rest of the run
Permission gate (one check before every tool call)
ask = once / always / deny · no UI to ask → refuse (fail closed)
one system message: base prompt + untrusted-content notice
+ core profile & memory (read from Memory) · compaction at 80 %
tiers REGULAR · CONFIRM · STRICT · DENY (config deny_tools)
'always' for CONFIRM only · one instance, shared by all loops
ToolRegistry — one registry: built-in, MCP and delegation tools are called the same way
at the start of every run
each sub-agent = its own ReactLoop, role, max_steps,
same PermissionPolicy · approvals asked via parent
events nested under the parent run (run_id)
result returned to the parent as an observation
connect each configured server · discover tools once at startup
filter by tools: whitelist · tier via auto_tools / confirm_tools
stdio (JSON-RPC) · persistent session on its own asyncio thread
timeouts: 15 s connect · 30 s per call
failed server → warning, agent still starts
every layer emits lifecycle events: run · llm · tool · memory · permission · sub-agent
